column1: # name|ctx|mtp_depth|effort|max_tokens|need_mib|summary
# MEASURED on Apple M5 Max / 128 GB / macOS 26.4 / MLX 0.32.1 / mtplx 2.10.1,
# 2026-09-01. Metal's recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize on this machine is 110,100
# MiB; the pack wired 77.3 GB (79,155 MiB) at the `coding` settings.
# need_mib is the 77.3 GB (79,155 MiB) this pack was measured WIRED at during a
# real agent session. It is deliberately NOT the resident size the installer's
# smoke test reports.
# Those two numbers disagree by 48 GB, and the reason matters. This is a
# 512-expert MoE with 10 active per token. A two-token smoke generation touches
# a handful of experts, so the server tree's RSS reads ~30,821 MiB -- while the
# machine-wide figure moves by ~51 GB over the same load. Sizing the pre-flight
# from that RSS would under-warn by 48 GB and let the model be started on a
# machine that then swaps itself to a standstill.
# So: measured under real work, not under the smoke test. The dense 27B pack
# has no such gap and does use its measured RSS.
# The 29.8 GB n-gram table streams from SSD and is not wired, so it is not
# counted here. The KV cache was not separately instrumented.
#   profile     ctx      measured decode   effective   ttft
#   coding      131072   49.8 tok/s        38.8 tok/s  2.0 s
#   long        131072   (same settings, effort raised -- not separately timed)
# `coding` is the only row with an end-to-end measured session behind it.
# `long` differs from it ONLY in reasoning effort, which changes token volume
# rather than rate; it is listed because it is useful, not because it was
# timed independently.
coding|131072|3|low|32768|79155|default; the measured configuration -- 128k ctx, effort low
long|131072|3|medium|32768|79155|same sizing, more deliberation per turn; slower in wall-clock
